en: A map of Sinnoh. Veilstone City lies east of here, and Route 215 runs west through the rain toward Route 210.
text: O hartă a Sinnoh-ului. Orașul Veilstone se află la est de aici, iar Ruta 215 merge spre vest, prin ploaie, spre Ruta 210.
